name: – Nacho Sánchez Amor – After § 6 – Am 40
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Türkiye
part_text: 6a. Urges the EU institutions to strengthen monitoring mechanisms regarding Türkiye’s ties to the Muslim Brotherhood and affiliated networks in Europe, given their role in fostering extremist narratives and undermining social cohesion and security in the Member States;
